source: cape-jones/tools/rigging/ (BlenRig fit/setup/warp, joint_detect, weight cage) + cape-jones/blender523-rig-fixed-20261101 + blender523-rig-refined-20261101
target: western-heart tools/retarget/ — WH-Canonical-22 (lab/skeleton/canonical_skeleton.json) + Mixamo49 finger/toe extension (tools/retarget/tekken-bonemap.json)
location_justification: tools/retarget/ is WH's existing retarget home (README, tekken-bonemap.json, tekken_skeleton_base.json, tests/). tools/auto_rig/ is the GameRig creation backend, tools/rig-guard/ is only a MODEL_URLS guard, and tools/rig-repair/ is repair — none of them is a fit/retarget library. This subdir keeps all retarget wiring in one place and touches no existing file.
skeleton_differences: Scale/proportion: Cape Jones toon is 0.9248 m; BlenRig fit shrinks the 1.70 m default biped by 0.544. WH characters are realistic-proportioned: cape_rig.fit_guides() defaults rest_scale=1.0 and fits in target space; the 0.544 factor is opt-in only.

Axis/space: Cape Jones joint detection is Z-up, faces -Y, L=+X, feet at z=0. WH-Canonical-22 is Y-up, faces +Z, left=+X, bind pose is a fighting stance with identity rest rotations. Convert with cape_rig.to_wh_space() before feeding WH data; do not feed CJ-space joints straight into a WH rig.

Bone count/shape: Cape Jones show rig is 94 bones (asserted in retarget_idle_cape.py) plus BlenRig *_str guides and pole bones, plus cape bones. WH-Canonical-22 has 22 core bones and no cape, guide or pole bones. The Mixamo49 extension adds full finger chains and toes.

Spine: Cape Jones uses spine_1..spine_4 + chest (5 segments). WH-Canonical-22 has Spine + Chest only, so CJ spine_1/spine_2 collapse to Spine and spine_3/spine_4/chest collapse to Chest (see show-retarget bonemap for the motion-averaging rule).

Fingers: Cape Jones guides build 4 fingers x 5 segments + thumb x 4 per side. WH-Canonical-22 drops fingers entirely (see tekken-bonemap.json 'drop'); Mixamo49 targets keep thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky x 3. Map by finger name, not by segment count — extra CJ finger segments are averaged onto the 3-segment WH chain, never invented as new WH bones.

MB-Lab 71-joint note (honest gap): the wiring brief names a 71-joint MB-Lab skeleton, but no 71-name list was found in tools/retarget/ or tools/mb-lab/ at the base head — those dirs carry the 22-bone canonical rig, the 60-bone base skeleton and the MB-Lab generator (tools/mb-lab/README.md: MB-Lab skeleton -> retargeted to the WH canonical rig). cape_rig.py is therefore skeleton-agnostic: pass a caller-supplied target joint list (e.g. exported from a generated MB-Lab GLB) and unmapped joints hold rest and are reported by QA, rather than inventing 71 names here.
Cape: Cape Jones cape/collar are rigged pieces, not skeleton bones in the WH sense. They map to the WH cape accessory system (tools/cape/), not to WH skeleton joints. See seating rules below.

blender523_seating_gate.note: 2D toon peg rules from blender523-rig-fixed/refined reports, carried as a POSE/SEATING gate only. The refined build is 17 pegs + 11 drawings + FK 6/6, gate PASS_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITS; it is NOT a 3D skeleton and no .blend is copied here.
blender523_seating_gate.arm_identity: ARM1 = viewer-left = Arm_Front, ARM2 = viewer-right = Arm_Back; LEG1 = viewer-left = Leg_Front, LEG2 = viewer-right = Leg_Back. 'Front/Back' in filenames is limb identity, not body-facing. A swapped build was wrong and was corrected in the fixed build — do not re-swap.
blender523_seating_gate.cape_parent: Cape_Back_Main is Torso-parented, top at shoulder level, bottom above the feet; never Root-parented towering above the head.
blender523_seating_gate.collar_z: Cape_Collar Z below Torso Z (fixed: collar 0.05, torso 0.08) so only the shoulder band shows, not a chest-covering bib.
blender523_seating_gate.head_neck: Head base sits on the neck (head base 2.89, neck centre 2.98, overlap 0.31 in fixed-build units); head centre pivot is wrong.
blender523_seating_gate.crossed_snap_z: Crossed arms at Z 0.11, above torso 0.08, below head 0.12.
blender523_seating_gate.flex: Flex is a 120 deg wide-out spread, NOT arms-up (whole pieces cannot do arms-up without a wrist cut, which is banned in that rig).
blender523_seating_gate.known_limits: Whole-piece limbs cannot match cut-limb elbow/knee bends exactly (refined report: worst rows still off by tens of px at fist/toe); true arms-up flex and a 48-frame EEVEE animation are not claimed.
